projects.name: Project Manager
details: Directed digital transformation projects for banking sales and service platforms, implementing front-to-back operating models to improve client experience and operational efficiency.
Managed complete project lifecycles covering planning, governance, risk management, stakeholder engagement, delivery execution and implementation.
Established governance structures and delivery controls across project work-streams, ensuring effective management of risks, issues, dependencies and delivery priorities.
Worked with cross-functional business and technology teams to translate requirements into digital solutions and optimize business processes and workflows.
Coordinated stakeholders across functions to resolve delivery constraints, clarify ownership and maintain alignment with project objectives.
Implemented quality assurance and governance processes across SDLC phases to support controlled and predictable delivery.
Oversaw project budgets, financials and KPIs, providing management visibility into delivery performance and project objectives.
